info.title: BG Tutor API
info.description: Local headless backgammon library with GNUbg and Open Sage analysis. No authentication; bind to loopback.

parameters.description:
Sort field: id (or match_no), created_at, played_at, name, white, black,
white_pr, black_pr, match_length, score, result, tournament, format,
position_count, analysis_status, tags, or comment. With position_id, also
occurrence_database (case-insensitive name), occurrence_game, occurrence_move.
score compares the
visible numeric white/black score pair; result retains result-state order.

asc or desc (default desc). Missing values sort last in either direction;
equal values use ascending UUID order for stable pagination.

game_no.description: Restrict a match analysis source to this source game.

position_ids.description: Saved position UUIDs in selection order. Every occurrence receives an outcome.

items.description: Outcomes in the same order as the request, including repeated UUIDs.

complete.description: True only when the native scope has completed durable coverage.

oneOf.description: Effective selection, also returned when it is outside the current page.

selected_id.description: Explicit persisted identity; null means the automatic policy is active.

oneOf.description: Selected game's checkpoint from a whole-match analysis.

analysis_id.description: Null returns the match to the shared automatic policy.

statistics.description: Authoritative native statistics. Absent if the export cannot prove full coverage.

comment.description: Plaintext Markdown; never interpreted as trusted HTML.

id.description: Null for an existing target without a saved annotation.

version.description: Zero until first save. Supply this value as expected_version when saving.

total.description: Total matching rows when `page` is supplied.

gnubg_threads.description: Host-local override. Null uses one GNUbg calculation thread. Omit on PUT to keep the saved value.

open_sage_threads.description: Host-local override. Null uses four threads for analysis and two for play. Omit on PUT to keep the saved value.

version.description: Expected revision on PUT; a successful write increments it by one.

startup_elapsed_ms.description: Cold Open Sage worker initialization, outside the warm pipeline timer.

xg_path.description: Omission preserves a previously configured XG path.

depth.description: Decisions into the game; this is not evaluation ply.

equity_kind.description: Cubeful equity normalized to the current cube (match play uses GNUbg NEMG).

path.description: Ordered checker steps supplied by the engine, when available.

plies.description: Depth actually used for this candidate, when recorded by the engine.

probabilities.description:
Win, win gammon (including backgammon), win backgammon,
loss, lose gammon (including backgammon), lose backgammon.

browse.description: Library metadata only; engine answers remain behind explicit reveal.

total.description: Matching cards before applying the cursor; a shared card appears once.

page.description: One-based result page. Mutually exclusive with `after`.

player.description: Literal substring of the name of the player on roll.

q.description: Literal substring of players, question, IDs, deck names, tags or comments.

oneOf.description: New and due may overlap. Reviewed means at least one completed review.

topics.description: Comma-separated card tags. Each term includes its descendants.

without_deck.description: Include only cards without a deck membership.

players.description: Absolute colors: White, Black. Empty for Anki cards.

recurring_matches.description: Includes the current match when the group occurs in multiple matches.

has_analysis.description: False when no completed native analysis is available for any game.

history_available.description: False when the history exceeds the recurring-mistake query bounds.

steps.description: Complete ordered checker steps in board coordinates. An empty list is a forced pass.

equity_loss.description: Best minus played normalized cubeful equity, from the mover's perspective.

analysis_board_width.description: Preferred board pane width in Study cards; null uses the responsive default.

analysis_errors_board_width.description: Preferred board pane width in the Errors tab; null uses the responsive default.

analysis_notes_board_width.description: Preferred board pane width in the Notes tab; null uses the responsive default.

analysis_overview_board_width.description: Preferred board pane width in the analysis overview; null uses the responsive default.

analysis_statistics_board_width.description: Preferred board pane width in the Statistics tab; null uses the responsive default.

match_length.description: Zero starts a continuous money-game session; 1..25 starts a point match.

away.description: Points still needed by White and Black; absent in money play.

cube_owner.description: 0 White, 1 Black, absent while the cube is centered.

cube_value.description: Cube value before a pending offer.

doubler.description: Absolute color of the player who offers or considers the double.

post_crawford.description: A one-away score after the Crawford game has been played.

scores.description: Points scored so far by White and Black.

oneOf.description: Absent when no double is possible or the score is outside the table.

doubler.description: Absolute color of the player who doubles: 0 White, 1 Black.

match_id.description: GNUbg match ID of the decision; a pending offer keeps the previous cube value.

CubeEvaluation.description: Recorded cube outcomes, from the player making the decision.

probabilities.description:
Cubeless win, gammon and backgammon chances followed by the three
losing chances, for the same player. Absent in older checkpoints and
for sources that do not record them.

match_no.description: Persistent numeric library entry ID; UUID remains the action identity.

oneOf.description: Present in position-filtered results, where every stored occurrence is a row.

play_paused.description: A live play checkpoint that must be explicitly resumed.

player_sides.description:
Sides belonging to the requested player profile, when filtered by player_id.
0 is White and 1 is Black. Both may belong to the same profile.

source_available.description: False for independent saved-position context whose source match was deleted.

study_report_id.description: Saved learning report available for this match; never implies generation.

best.description: Best checker notation or cube action under the native evaluation.

best_equity.description: Best normalized cubeful equity from this player's perspective, in the same units.

checker_candidates.description: Ranked alternatives saved by local game and match analyses.

checker_no.description:
One-based imported checker position; also links its preceding no-double decision.
Actual double/take/drop decisions have no checker number.

oneOf.description: Saved outcomes. Older checkpoints may only contain played and best equity.

decision_no.description: One-based sequence of all checker and cube decisions within this game.

dice.description: The original imported dice for checker decisions; absent for cube decisions.

equity_loss.description: Nonnegative best-minus-played equity, rounded to GNUbg's six exported decimals.

evaluation_status.description:
"evaluated" or "forced". A forced dance has null equities and zero loss;
missing analysis for any evaluable decision fails the game analysis.

played.description: Actual GNUbg checker notation, or "no double", "double", "take", "drop".

played_equity.description:
Normalized cubeful equity of the actual decision, from this player's perspective.
Cube equities use the cube value before an offer, including for its response.

player.description: Absolute color: 0 is White, 1 is Black.

severity.description: Saved decision severity. Analysis views can reclassify the stored equity loss.

away.description: Points still needed by the deciding player and the opponent.

cube_owner.description: Absolute color; absent while the cube is centered.

oneOf.description: Error type when the played action was not best.

practicable.description: True when the practice endpoints accept this reference.

version.description: Changes when the deck is renamed or gains memberships.

max_parallel_threads.description: Upper bound on simultaneous CPU execution for this engine on the backend host.

EngineSnapshot.description: Internal job payload, never derived again from mutable application settings.

oneOf.description: Saved checker move filter. Older snapshots use GNUbg startup defaults.

ErrorThresholds.description: Inclusive lower bounds of the four grades, measured in normalized equity.

analyzed.description: True only when this source game has a durable, complete checkpoint for this job.

error_breakdown.description: Typed errors for this complete checkpoint; null for missing or inconsistent durable coverage.

oneOf.description: Null before checkpointing. Legacy checkpoints provide decision totals but no native game PR.

game_over.description:
At least one side has no checkers remaining, including on the bar.
Labels retain the original rule classification for terminal boards.

source_revision.description: Pinned upstream Git commit; changes when the reference rules change.

cube.description: Accepted cube value, before any declined offer.

multiplier.description: Only present when the source supports this cube calculation.

evaluated.description: Source contains recorded evaluation values; this does not imply comparable units.

oneOf.description: Immutable provider, installation and model identity; absent for legacy GNUbg work.

game_no.description: Source game number for a single-game match analysis; null means the whole match.

error_breakdown.description: Typed errors in checkpointed games; null when durable decision coverage cannot be verified.

games.description: Ordered source games in this job's scope. Coverage requires a committed game checkpoint.

oneOf.description: The authoritative persisted job summary, including partial progress; null before any summary exists.

JobProgress.description: JSON encoded in the `data:` line of each job SSE message.

oneOf.description: Provider for this job; omitted uses the saved analysis engine.

kind.description: A ranked candidate analysis or a distribution over 21 weighted rolls.

plies.description: Verified search depth of the selected engine. Omitted uses saved analysis depth.

position_id.description: Database UUID of the imported position, not its GNUbg ID.

new_cards_per_day.description: New flashcards introduced per local day; 0 pauses new cards.

due_count.description: Every card whose due time has passed, including never-reviewed cards.

new_available_today.description: New cards still allowed today, at most `new_count`.

new_count.description: Due cards in a deck that have never been reviewed.

oneOf.description: Deck of the next card to study today.

review_due_count.description: Due cards that have been reviewed before.

today_count.description: Due reviews plus the new cards still allowed today.

LibraryOccurrence.description: One stored occurrence of the searched checker position.

total.description: Total matching rows when `page` is supplied.

oneOf.description: Provider for this job; omitted uses the saved analysis engine.

game_no.description: Analyze one source game in its original match context; omitted means the whole match.

plies.description: Verified checker and cube depth of the selected engine. Omitted uses saved analysis depth.

oneOf.description:
Native GNUbg normalized loss and non-trivial decision denominator.
Missing for legacy results or if any analyzed game lacks native statistics.
Terminal source evidence, an explicit award, or an unambiguous delta established by both explicit next-game scores.

source_available.description: False for retained saved-position context after the source match was deleted.

oneOf.description: Null when the decision type has no defined set of opportunities.

best.description: Answers that matched the best decision.

day.description: Day in the database server's time zone.

items.description: Newest day first; at most 500 day-and-group rows.

decision_count.description:
Evaluable decisions in the same game plan and decision category,
independent of the error threshold. Cube categories use the best action.

error_rate.description: Fraction of those decisions that meet the positive loss threshold.

loss_per_100.description: Sum of qualifying normalized equity losses per 100 evaluable decisions.

small_sample.description: True when there are fewer than 30 evaluable decisions.

oneOf.description:
Error rate in the earlier and the recent half of the player's matches.
Null unless both halves hold at least 10 evaluable decisions.

position_uuid.description: Imported board before this checker move; cube-only decisions have no checker board.

best.description: Checker notation of the two plays to compare.

board.description: Absolute-color board before the play, as in the game-plan request.

MoveSeverity.description: Decision severity for normalized equity loss. Existing category identifiers are retained.

normalized_equity_loss.description: GNUbg's combined normalized Error total EMG, exported to six decimals.

games.description: Number of games contributing complete native statistics.

method.description:
gnubg_emg_500_v1: 500 × native normalized loss / (unforced checker + close/actual cube).
GNUbg counting is not interchangeable with XG or BMAB counting.

resign_level.description:
Resign the current game for a single (1), gammon (2), or backgammon (3).
Required for resign; invalid for every other action.

blots.description: The mover's single checkers on points 1 to 24, as point numbers.

hitting_rolls.description: Opponent rolls out of 36 that can hit one of those blots.

home_points.description: Held points among the mover's home points 1 to 6.

longest_prime.description: Longest run of adjacent held points.

opponent_on_bar.description: Opponent checkers on the bar after the play.

points.description: Points the mover holds with two or more checkers.

PlayGameResult.description: Completed source games, attached after their final played history event.

PlayHistorySnapshots.description: Read-only snapshots aligned one-for-one with the saved session history.

first_attempt_loss.description: Sum of first attempted losses; not a performance rating.

first_attempt_rating.description: EMG500 of original choices on reached positions, using native relevance.

games.description: Actual played match only; native statistics preserve GNUbg's denominator.

library_match_id.description: Current linked library entry; projected from the relational session link.

match_forfeited.description: The human conceded the entire point match.

money_session_ended.description: An explicitly closed money session cannot start another game.

paused.description: The saved checkpoint is available for explicit resumption.

checker_equity_loss.description: Sum of normalized equity losses, not a performance rating (PR).

total.description: Total matching players when `page` is supplied.

value.description: Null if the native denominator is zero; lower values indicate less equity lost.

PlayerRatingPoint.description: One fully analyzed match of the player, for a rating trend.

checker_value.description:
The same rating for checker play alone: saved checker losses over
unforced checker plays. Absent without such plays.

cube_value.description: The remaining loss over close cube decisions. Absent without them.

date.description: Date played, or the import date when the match records none.

decisions.description: Unforced checker plays and close cube decisions behind the value.

oneOf.description: Alias responsible for the hit when the visible name does not match.

position_id.description: UUID of the exact imported occurrence, retaining its player and source context.

cube_owner.description: -1: centered; 0: White; 1: Black; null: unknown source context.

decks.description: Learning decks for this checker decision's full Position-ID/Match-ID identity.

match_no.description: Persistent library number, independent of the match UUID and row order.

source_available.description: False when only saved occurrences remain after source deletion.

total.description: Total matching rows when `page` is supplied.

oneOf.description:
Omitted: loss descending; all other columns ascending. Legacy definitions
omit this field when serialized to preserve their stored definition format.
Open Sage plan for the player on roll.

min_loss.description: Selected normalized equity loss. Individual hints do not imply a played-move loss.

player.description: Literal name substring of the player on roll, rather than either match participant.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor; continue with the same filters.

oneOf.description: All cube outcomes behind a cube answer, from the answering player.

again.description: Seconds until due for each rating; Again and initial Hard use learning steps.

due.description: Due cards that have been reviewed before.

new.description: Due cards that have never been reviewed.

new_available.description: New cards of this deck still allowed today.

move_id.description: Source event for cube review; a skipped double links its checker event.

next_checker_no.description: Next checker move for an explicit cube event; null after the last checker move.

oneOf.description: Exact cube context, including the position before the roll for a skipped double.

next_cursor.description: A bounded scan can return an empty page with a continuation. Follow it until null.

total.description: Total matching decisions when `page` is supplied.

one_ply_verified.description: Capability proven during installation verification; absent in legacy snapshots.

completed_at.description: Time the user finished the round, preserved across save retries.

id.description: Stable round ID for safe retries after a lost response.

losses.description: One loss for every scored move, including correct plays with zero loss.

oneOf.description: Original candidates from a saved individual-position calculation.
Native match/game decision with best, played, and alternatives when recorded.

records.description: Original imported candidates, cube values, units and perspective.

distance.description: Minimum checker-pips needed to transform one arrangement into the other.

equity_loss.description:
Loss of the played move in the match's displayed native analysis;
null without one.

items.description: Up to 50 checker occurrences, nearest first.

move_no.description: One-based actual source event, including explicit cube actions.

position_uuid.description: Checker notes use this canonical position occurrence; cube notes use id.

session_scores.description: Current cumulative session score; never the sum of per-report scores.

table.description: Match equity table name; absent in money play.

value.description: Game winning chance the taker needs, from 0 to 1.

file.description: One MAT, SGF, binary XG, BGBlitz BGF, or HedgeHog OGXM file, at most 16 MiB including multipart envelope.
